_about: Local DAS Tool 1.1.7 refinement path for the 39 salterns assemblies in ws 275645. Recommended: BinnedContigs save -> MetagenomeUtils extract (beta) -> kb_Msuite CheckM (beta). Placeholders in <angle brackets>. Nothing here was sent to KBase; all tests were read-only.

calls: AbstractHandle.hids_to_handles([[<fasta_handle_ref>]])  -> handle.id = Blobstore node; handle.url may be https://services.kbase.us/services/shock-api (unreachable from here) -> ignore it
step1_download_assembly.checks: md5(bytes) == node md5 == handle remote_md5; gunzip if magic 1f8b; first-word ids, lengths, per-contig md5 == Assembly contigs; md5(','.join(sorted(contig md5s))) == Assembly md5; rewrite headers to '>' + first word if any header has a description (MEGAHIT fallback assemblies do)

step2_contig2bin.source: for b in (metabat, maxbin, concoct) with ledger state done: Workspace.get_objects2([{'objects': [{'ref': output_of(ledger, b, s), 'included': ['/assembly_ref', '/bins/[*]/bid', '/bins/[*]/contigs']}]}])
step2_contig2bin.tsv_line: <contig_id>\t<label>.<bid without .fasta>\n, no header; labels metabat2 / maxbin2 / concoct
step2_contig2bin.checks: data.assembly_ref == the downloaded Assembly UPA; every contig id is a FASTA id; contigs[cid].len == FASTA length; no contig twice within a binner

step2b_dastool_command.why: same thresholds the pipeline sends to kb_das_tool (pipeline.py:223-225); -t 8 because load is ~21/64; drop the -i/-l entry of a binner whose task is 'empty'
step2b_dastool_command.success: exit 0 AND <prefix>_DASTool_summary.tsv + <prefix>_DASTool_contig2bin.tsv non-empty; exit 1 + 'No bins with bin-score >0.5' in <prefix>_DASTool.log = stage 'empty'

data.assembly_ref: <275645/objid/ver of the sample's Assembly, exactly the one the binners used>

bins.bid: <DAS Tool label>.fasta, e.g. metabat2.bin.003.fasta or concoct.bin.018_sub.fasta

provenance.description: DAS Tool 1.1.7 run locally on <host> over metabat2, maxbin2, concoct BinnedContigs ...

key_justification.type: KBaseMetagenomes.BinnedContigs-1.0 is the only version (Workspace.get_type_info); required assembly_ref, bins, total_contig_len; bin requires bid, contigs, n_contigs, gc, sum_contig_len; contig requires gc, len
key_justification.name: = pipeline names()['dastool'] (pipeline.py:106) so the ledger/adoption logic (pipeline.py:324-326) and the extract stage stay unchanged
key_justification.assembly_ref: @id ws KBaseGenomeAnnotations.Assembly; extract reads ONLY this, bins[].bid and contig keys (MetagenomeFileUtils.py:723-762 @54c6bc35)
key_justification.bid: becomes the extracted Assembly name prefix (bid + assembly_suffix, MetagenomeFileUtils.py:964) and is comma-joined into extracted_assemblies, so no ',' and only [A-Za-z0-9|._-]
key_justification.contigs gc/len: taken from the Assembly object as KBase binners do (MetagenomeFileUtils.py:278-304)
key_justification.cov: optional in the type; 0.0 = what kb_das_tool's own output holds (272312/963/1); kb_Msuite withFilter reads bins[].cov (DataStagingUtils.py:356-381 @7495e02e)
key_justification.provenance.time format: accepted by the WS in the earlier writebacks (~/gtdbtk_kbase/kbase_mags.py:263,290)

step3_save_binnedcontigs.implementation: scripts/dastool_to_binnedcontigs.py (builds + JSON-schema-validates the params and a predicted-Assembly manifest; does not save)

step4_extract.clientgroup: njs (no Catalog config; EE2 records cpu 12, memory 10000, disk 100)

key_justification.binned_contig_obj_ref: resolved-ref in NMS; pass the absolute UPA
key_justification.extracted_assemblies: comma string split at MetagenomeFileUtils.py:939; '' would extract every bin (:952-954) but explicit is what the pipeline sends (pipeline.py:230-234)
key_justification.assembly_suffix: required (:138-141); names become '<bid>__<s>' like the wetland 'bin.006.fasta__SRR10127268'
key_justification.assembly_set_name: required when >1 bin (:152-154); the set is only saved when >1 Assembly was made (:978-991)

step4_extract.post_check: each new Assembly's info meta MD5 / N Contigs / Size == the predicted manifest (8/8 matched on SRR10489822)

step5_checkm.clientgroup: njs (no Catalog config; cpu 12, memory 10000, disk 100 on all 129 past kb_Msuite jobs)

key_justification.input_ref: AssemblySet accepted (DataStagingUtils.py:94-124): each item staged as '<Assembly name>.fna', so CheckM 'Bin Name' = Assembly object name; a bare Assembly ref also works (:81-90) for single-bin samples
key_justification.reduced_tree: '1' -> --reduced_tree (CheckMUtil.py:66-68, 229-230); '0' = full tree, 40+ GB, would not fit the 10 GB njs request
key_justification.save_plots_dir: '0' skips plots.zip (CheckMUtil.py:393-399); plots are still computed (:95-96)
key_justification.threads: inert: CheckMUtil uses config['threads'] (CheckMUtil.py:31) = 4 (deploy.cfg:13); kept because the NMS constant maps it

report_files.CheckM_summary_table.tsv.zip: zip member CheckM_summary_table.tsv; columns Bin Name, Marker Lineage, # Genomes, # Markers, # Marker Sets, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5+, Completeness, Contamination (2 dp) (OutputBuilder.py:253-313)
report_files.full_output.zip: storage/bin_stats_ext.tsv = '<bin>\t<python dict>' per bin, full precision (+ Genome size, GC, N50, ...)
report_files.download: file_links[].URL with services.kbase.us -> kbase.us, + '?download', header Authorization: OAuth <token>

step5_checkm.selection: float(bin_stats_ext[bin]['Completeness']) >= 50 and float(...['Contamination']) < 10; map Bin Name -> AssemblySet item via object names

alternative_A_staging_plus_batch_import_.upload: POST https://kbase.us/services/staging_service/upload (service 1.4.0; 401 without auth), header Authorization: <raw token>, multipart part 'destPath' = '<dir relative to the user root>' FIRST, then part 'uploads' = the file; names must not start with ' ' or '.', must not contain ','; one request per file (staging_service app.py:418-483 @5eff277d)
alternative_A_staging_plus_batch_import_.why_not: names forced to '<file stem>_<dir path, / -> _>' with a mount-dependent suffix (BatchUtil.py:65-82,97-111); per-file failures swallowed and the job still completes (:181-201,305-315); serial AssemblyUtil save per file, 310 files took 317 min (job 5fb4bbeebff87f4c5d430055); min_contig_length must be a JSON int (FastaToAssembly.py:367-372); needs staging writes and re-uploads bytes KBase already holds

alternative_A2_one_import_job_per_bin_NO.why_not: 1,000-3,000 kb_upload jobs and no AssemblySet (one would have to be saved separately)

calls: POST https://kbase.us/services/shock-api/node?filename=<name> raw body, Authorization: OAuth <token> (multipart without per-part Content-Length = HTTP 400)

Workspace.save_objects([{'id': 275645, 'objects': [{'type': 'KBaseGenomeAnnotations.Assembly-5.1', 'name': ..., 'data': {AssemblyUtil._parse_fasta fields + assembly_id, type, fasta_handle_ref: hid}, 'provenance': [...]}]}]) per bin, then one KBaseSets.AssemblySet-1.2 {description, items[{ref, label}]}
alternative_B_direct_blob_handle_ws_NOT_.why_not: hand-builds 1,000-3,000 Assembly objects (md5, base_counts, gc, Ncount, handle) outside AssemblyUtil for bytes already in KBase; only the blob upload + persist_handle part was ever exercised here (~/gtdbtk_kbase/writeback_r232.py:563-589, report files)
